doc:
# Flat Space — Amplitudes

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “flat space holography”).

claims.name: study_initiates_flatspace_holography_mmg
claims.statement: The study initiates flat-space holography for MMG.

claims.name: potential_applications_include_tensionless_strings
claims.statement: Potential applications include tensionless strings and flat-space holography.

sources.title: Carroll covariant scalar fields in two dimensions

claims.name: carroll_fracton_symmetries_important_flatspace
claims.statement: Carroll and fracton symmetries are important for flat-space holography.

claims.name: holographic_match_provides_further_evidence
claims.statement: The holographic match provides further evidence for flat space holography.

claims.name: celestial_holography_provides_new_way
claims.statement: Celestial holography provides a new way to understand flat-space amplitudes.

sources.title: Celestial self-dual Yang-Mills theory: a new formula and the OPE limit

claims.name: theories_under_consideration_appear_context
claims.statement: The theories under consideration appear in the context of flat space holography.

sources.title: Local quantum energy conditions in non-Lorentz-invariant quantum field theories

claims.name: cfunction_obtained_theory_using_flatspace
claims.statement: A C-function is obtained for this theory using flat-space holography.

sources.title: Aspects of Ultra-Relativistic Field Theories via Flat-space Holography

claims.name: realizing_carrollian_duals_gravitational_theories
claims.statement: Realizing Carrollian duals to gravitational theories poses challenges for flat space holography.

claims.name: nontrivial_cft_correlators_used_study
claims.statement: Non-trivial CFT correlators can be used to study non-trivial scattering processes in asymptotically flat space-times via flat-space holography.

claims.name: conformal_chernsimons_gravity_admits_antide
claims.statement: Conformal Chern-Simons gravity admits Anti-de Sitter, Lobachevsky, and flat-space holography.

claims.name: results_have_implications_flat_space
claims.statement: The results have implications for flat space holography and the BMS charges at $I^{+}$.

sources.title: Asymptotic Charges Cannot Be Measured in Finite Time

claims.name: asymptotic_causal_diamonds_provide_organizing
claims.statement: Asymptotic causal diamonds provide a organizing structure for bulk locality in flat space holography.

sources.title: Bulk Locality and Asymptotic Causal Diamonds

claims.name: checks_flat_space_holography_summarized
claims.statement: Checks of flat space holography are summarized in the context of topologically massive gravity.

sources.title: Free energy of topologically massive gravity and flat space holography

claims.name: resulting_theory_obtained_flat_space
claims.statement: The resulting theory can be obtained as a flat space limit of $NAdS_2$ holography and provides a solution to flat space JT gravity.

claims.name: null_boundary_field_theory_flat
claims.statement: The null boundary field theory in flat space admits a first-principle intrinsic derivation independent of bulk considerations, supporting flat-space holography and dimensional reduction.

sources.title: Extended-BMS Anomalies and Flat Space Holography

claims.name: explicit_map_gravity_established_yielding
claims.statement: An explicit map with 3d gravity is established, yielding new predictions for flat space holography.

sources.title: $T\bar T + Λ_2$ from a 2d gravity path integral

claims.name: ebg_nonrelativistic_analogue_einstein_gravity
claims.statement: EBG is the non-relativistic analogue of Einstein gravity in flat space-time and can be used to study flat-space holography in non-relativistic limit.

claims.name: flat_space_holography_point_function
claims.statement: For flat space holography, the 2-point function of stress tensor in flat space Einstein gravity gives central charge $c=6k=\frac{3\ell}{2G_{N}}$

sources.title: Stress tensor correlators in three-dimensional gravity
